findings.evidence: Its statement quantifies over an arbitrary predicate `P` on restricted sections and uses no ideal-sheaf or Cartier-divisor notion; `Scheme/Opens.lean` already contains general `appLE` and affine-open gluing results.

summary: Several broadly reusable structure-sheaf and flat-morphism lemmas are misplaced in an effective-Cartier-divisor module.
